report.summary: Outbox publication stalled for about 90 s (14:54:23 to 14:55:03) while transfers kept committing, so notifications were delayed. The cause is not determined: delivery logs and blocker samples are missing.

findings.claim: Outbox publications dropped to 0 for nine consecutive 10 s buckets while arrivals stayed steady at 32 per bucket, then resumed at 80 per bucket.
findings.reason: Per-bucket counts show a stall followed by catch-up. Arrivals minus publications was 146 over the window.

findings.claim: Notification delay grew with the stall: oldest undelivered age rose from 0.4 s to 118.9 s and pending peaked at 285, with no FAILED rows.
findings.reason: The backlog built up and was draining at the end, matching customers seeing late notifications.

findings.claim: The delay is not on the transfer API or the DB connection pool. Transfers returned 201 with p99 of 0.25 s and no 500s, and the pool had no pending borrowers or timeouts.
findings.reason: Request latency, error ratio and pool gauges were all healthy and complete.

limitations: Delivery logs and timings are PARTIAL with zero records, so attempt outcomes and consumer latency are unknown.
